translations.home.hero.title: Together, We Choose
translations.home.hero.subtitle: Our Future Family Name
translations.home.hero.paragraph1: This page helps you choose your future family name together. It offers guidance and useful information.
translations.home.hero.paragraph2: No matter what, always embrace your uniqueness. The family name means something different to each of us. There is no right or wrong choice. There is no simple decision tree. Be empathic toward your partner's and your family's feelings.
translations.home.hero.paragraph3: Read on and make your thoughtful, shared choice!
translations.home.quick-nav.title: About this page
translations.home.quick-nav.description: Scroll down or jump directly to a section:
translations.home.quick-nav.link.feedback: {$START_TAG_MAT_ICON}link{$CLOSE_TAG_MAT_ICON} We'd love to hear from you
translations.home.why.title: Why your choice matters
translations.home.why.paragraph1: Traditionally, the wife often adopted the husband's family name. But in our modern, emancipated society we can do better than making a choice only based on tradition.
translations.home.why.paragraph2: Here are a few reasons, why your choice matters:
translations.home.why.emotional.title: Emotional connection
translations.home.why.emotional.content: Names can carry identity, history, emotional and more - for you, your siblings, parents and grandparents. Your feelings, your partner's feelings and your family's feelings deserve respect.
translations.home.why.legal.title: Legal restrictions
translations.home.why.legal.content: Your options will vary by country and region. Can you combine names or create a new one? What about legal implications for future children's surnames? Check local laws or ask your registrar.
translations.home.why.equality.title: Equality in partnership
translations.home.why.equality.content: Although it is tradition for the wife to adopt the husband's family name, nobody should take that for granted. Respect each other's feelings and find compromises.
translations.home.why.individual.title: Your individual reasons
translations.home.why.individual.content: Your reasons are individual and personal. There's no single right answer. {$START_TAG_STRONG}So, start the conversation and discuss what matters to you.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}
translations.home.questions.title: Questions to discuss together
translations.home.questions.paragraph: Here are some questions to consider and give you a good start:
translations.home.questions.personal.title: Personal attachment
translations.home.questions.personal.content: How attached are you to your family name? Is it your nickname? Are there stories or traditions tied to it? Do you connect values from your parents with it, you're proud of? Does it feel connected to 'home'?”
translations.home.questions.convenient.title: Convenient matters
translations.home.questions.convenient.content: Has one family name a special nice sound to it? Which name is easier to spell?
translations.home.questions.professional.title: Professional reasons
translations.home.questions.professional.content: Are your names part of your professional identity or business? Do you publish, perform, or have recognition under your current name?
translations.home.questions.children.title: Children
translations.home.questions.children.content: If you plan to have children, learn how local rules affect their surnames. If you both keep your names, your children may be allowed only one. In everyday situations (doctor’s office, school), different surnames can sometimes be awkward.
translations.home.questions.heritage.title: Family heritage
translations.home.questions.heritage.content: Is family heritage important to you? Is your family name meaningful to your parents or grandparents?
translations.home.questions.more.title: And many more…
translations.home.questions.more.content: Reflect on what matters to you. Be honest with each other. Embrace your uniqueness. Take your time.

translations.home.feedback.title: We'd love to hear from you
translations.home.feedback.description: Tell us what's missing, what helped, or what's still unclear so we can keep improving.
